description_en: Lists the security capabilities of normalization rules

kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-rule-capacities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-rule-id nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --normalization-rule-ids nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationRuleCapacities

parameters.help_en:
The region of the threat analysis Data Management Center. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside the Chinese mainland

威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域

en: English
